$about: R1 — the single canonical token set for the AhaSlides design-system-for-agents. Resolved from two disagreeing sources; see TOKENS.canonical.md for the ledger.
$precedence: MEASURED component-standard contract.json (what ships) > DS EXPORT (brand/identity/palette, Brian's stated SoT) > aha-design SKILL data (rules/format). Non-canonical skill bolt-ons (Tailwind neutrals, black-alpha text) discarded.

color.$source: Full color system, transcribed from the DS-EXPORT (palette.css + semantic.css), which is 'verbatim from the Figma DS V3 Variable collections'. Verified 2026-09-08. Two corrections applied per Brian: bgContainerDisabled gray-40→gray-30 (Figma bg-container-disabled); checkboxBorder off-palette #B4BCCF→gray-50 #D4D4D4.

button.$source: DS V3 Button component (Figma node 56611-11049) — latest & authoritative per Brian. Supersedes the older export for hover/fg where they disagreed.
button.$note: DS V3: primary hover #8644D4 (purple-50, NOT the export's #621BAF), fg #FDFDFD, secondary/tertiary hover brand-tint #F9F5FF + #A96FF0 border, danger active #CF1322, positive teal-40 #4EF1C5 w/ dark label, per-tone soft box-shadow focus ring (spread 2). encourage greens retained but off-palette.

viz.$source: Data-visualisation palette for <aha-chart>. Every value aliases ({color.…}) a SEMANTIC colour token from the Colour foundations page; generate.mjs emits var(--aha-…) in tokens.css and resolves hex in tokens.js. The DS has no dedicated categorical chart set, so the series use the page's Brand slots (Aha 1–13), brand purple first: brand-1 purple, brand-2 pink, brand-4 mint, brand-6 coral, brand-5 indigo, brand-10 periwinkle. Tints are the lightest semantic surface of each hue (bgAccent, brand-12, bgPositive, bgWarningSubtle, brand-11, bgInformative), used behind ink text. Ink is textDefault, the inverse is textInverse, and neutral (Other, non-correct Pick Answer) is iconMuted. Secondary/tertiary text, axis, grid, track, hover and mark outlines use textSecondary, textTertiary, borderStrong, border, borderSecondary, bgHover and inkA10 inside the element. Brand slots 4, 6 and 10 are light and fall below 3:1 against white; every mark also carries its value as text and a tooltip, so identity never relies on the fill alone. A deck-palette chart replaces the series with the deck's presentationColorPalette.

color.$note: Solid warm-gray text (export) chosen over the skill's black-alpha-of-indigo — alpha text is the dark-surface-invisible trap aha-design-antd itself warns about.

font.$note: NO Inter. The export (SoT) declares Inter a Figma-local system face, 'not a brand face, not loaded'. The skill's Inter label rule is from a different Figma frame and is overruled. Load product self-hosted (aha-design-antd).

weight.$note: 400/600 ONLY (design-owner decision 2026-09-14: 700 dropped from the product type scale — Display uses 600, not Bold). Export's unused 500 also removed. The sole remaining literal font-weight:700 is the MEASURED aha-tabs primary-tab active label (lib/aha-tabs.js) — a component-standard exception pending re-measure, not part of the scale.

size.$note: 18 (h6) added from skill; export's size-tiny 8px is spacing, not a text role — smallest text role is 10 (skill 'tiny').

lineHeight.$note: Unitless RATIOS, not px. body 1.5 → 21px at 14 — matches the MEASURED shipped components (checkbox 21px). The export token file's px line-heights (22/28) are drift from what ships; export's --aha-lh-tight:8px is a bug, discarded.

radius.$note: MEASURED wins: default=8 (button md / input / modal), card=12. Export MISLABELS default as 6 and lg as 8 — corrected. Export's radius-64 is off-scale (audit: likely 80) — see open items.

controlHeight.$note: MEASURED wins: fields (Input/Select/DatePicker) inherit root 32 (sm 24 / lg 40); Button carries 28/36/40/52 via components.Button. Export specimen field heights (32/36/40) are drift.

breakpoints.$note: From the export README; export space.css omits 375 (internal export nit) — README value used.

layout.$note: Default max-width for centred app content: the page/screen container caps here and centres with auto side margins (max-width:var(--aha-content-max-width); margin-inline:auto). 1440 is the DS V3 desktop content ceiling — one step above the 1280 desktop breakpoint. Consume via --aha-content-max-width. floatingInsetBottom is the bottom offset of a fixed bottom-right card (--aha-floating-inset-bottom), the presenter Import notification's 88px, which clears the editor's bottom bar; it is off the spacing scale, so it is a named token rather than a raw value.

effect.$source: Visual effects. blur.md is the frosted-glass backdrop blur behind translucent surfaces (chart tracks, chips, legend hover, mind-map controls), from the PRO38-69 chart mockup (--viz-backdrop-blur 20px). New token; px.
effect.$shadowSource: shadow.floating is the antd boxShadow elevation that the Notification and Message surfaces already render (Figma Elevate/Overlays); a floating card that is not an antd overlay binds to --aha-shadow-floating instead of copying the three layers.

layer.$source: Stacking order for fixed surfaces that live outside the browser top layer. floating (1100) sits above antd's popup base (1000), so a background-task card stays over open dropdowns and popovers.

viz.$source: Chart geometry + deck ink mixes for <aha-chart>. Geometry aliases the spacing scale ({space.N}) where a step exists; barThickness 38 and plotHeight 260 have no step and stay literal. Type sizes come from the type scale (--aha-size-*), not viz tokens. mix.* apply only to deck-palette charts, where the greys must be derived from the deck's own text colour; brand charts use the semantic text/border/bg tokens.

openItems: encourage-button greens (#2CB268/#168C4D/#12733F) exist in export semantic.css but in NO palette scale — add green primitives + alias, or drop the 'encourage' variant. DS-owner call.
radius-64: off the 4/6/8/12/16 scale; export README documents an 80px outlier, not 64 — confirm 80 or remove.
H5/H6 line-height: skill says 1.3; confirm against any shipped h5/h6 component.
